chain.label: Saab wire harness design lacked human-error protection
chain.trigger: Saab's design of the wheel speed transducer wire harnesses did not consider that the harnesses could be incorrectly installed during maintenance and overhaul

chain.label: Left MLG wheel speed transducer harnesses cross-wired during overhaul
chain.trigger: the landing gear manufacturer's incorrect wiring of the wheel speed transducer harnesses on the left MLG during overhaul

caused_by.evidence: unclear harness part numbers and the [equipment] operator following the process incorrectly

chain.label: Cross-wired antiskid harness undetected for 2.5 years
chain.trigger: the antiskid system does not generate a fault based on incorrect wiring...this cross-wiring condition was not discovered until after the accident

caused_by.evidence: as a result of the incorrect (crossed) wiring, the antiskid system performance was substantially compromised

chain.label: FAA authorized Saab 2000 at DUT without assessing RSA adequacy
chain.trigger: the FAA approved PenAir's use of the Saab 2000 on DUT runway 13/31 without considering whether the RSA at the airport was suitable...for an airplane with the approach speed and size of the Saab 2000

chain.label: PenAir improperly waived PIC airport qualification requirement
chain.trigger: PenAir allowed the captain to operate at DUT without gaining the experience that the company's policy intended

chain.label: Captain had limited Saab 2000 and DUT experience
chain.trigger: the captain might not have fully understood the challenges associated with landing the Saab 2000 at the airport

caused_by.evidence: PenAir allowed the captain to operate at DUT without gaining the experience that the company's policy intended

chain.label: Reported wind on runway 13 exceeded tailwind limit
chain.trigger: the wind at midfield was from 300° at 24 knots, indicating that a significant tailwind would be present during the landing

chain.label: Captain continued landing on runway 13 despite excessive tailwind
chain.trigger: the flight crew continued with the plan to land on runway 13...consistent with plan continuation bias

caused_by.evidence: a tailwind that exceeded the airplane manufacturer's limit
might not have fully understood the challenges associated with landing the Saab 2000 at the airport

chain.label: Antiskid system misread skidding wheel and released wrong brakes
chain.trigger: the antiskid system perceived that the left inboard wheel was skidding and released the brake pressure to that wheel and the right inboard wheel

caused_by.evidence: because of the crossed wiring, the antiskid system perceived that the left inboard wheel was skidding

chain.label: Left outboard tire skidded unchecked and burst
chain.trigger: the left outboard tire continued to skid and then burst, causing an additional loss of MLG wheel braking

caused_by.evidence: the left outboard tire continued to skid and then burst, causing an additional loss of MLG wheel braking

chain.label: Airplane overran runway 13, RSA, and blast pad
chain.trigger: the airplane overran the end of the runway and the adjacent 300-ft runway safety area...and came to rest beyond the airport property

caused_by.evidence: the combined loss of left and right inboard and left outboard MLG wheel braking prevented the flight crew from stopping the airplane on the runway
a landing in the opposite direction (on runway 31) would have favored the wind at the time
the accident airplane would have been able to stop within an RSA that was suitable for the approach speed and size of the Saab 2000

chain.label: One fatality, one serious injury, eight minor injuries
chain.trigger: 1 passenger sustained fatal injuries, and 1 passenger sustained serious injuries. Eight passengers sustained minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: The airplane was substantially damaged during the runway overrun; as a result...1 passenger sustained fatal injuries
